out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed gaps where piping runs above ceiling tiles in corner next to back exit doors.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Close all gaps in ceiling tiles.

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: large covered container of cut lettuce in #1 at 51F, cut lettuce in #2 at 48F, cut tomato in #2 at 46F, cut lettuce in #4 at 47F (all said to have been cut around 9:00AM).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). Lettuce discarded from all units. Tomato discarded. EHS will email cooling job aid.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: observed large container of cut lettuce with lid on in WIC; observed cut lettuce stored on false bottom insert on cold rail.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS discussed with CFM keeping lid off of large container of cut lettuce to facilitate cooling OR place freshly cut lettuce in WIF for period of time to speed up cooling. EHS recommends ceasing use of false bottom insert in containers so that maximum food surface area is in contact with cold rail.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: #2.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. Employee placed extra thermometer in unit.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label:squeeze bottles of oil and vinegar, spices in shake containers.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. Label all secondary containers with food name. JERSEY MIKE'S SUBS (Inspection Date: 06/18/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping cloths stored on hooks at main sandwich prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS discussed with CFM to keep wet wiping cloths in sanitizer bucket when not in use.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: #2 observed at 51F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. TCS FOODS: LETTUCE, TOMATO, CHEESE, CHICKEN, BEEF MOVED TO WIC OR #3. CFM TO REQUEST WORK ORDER FOR REPAIR OF UNIT. DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN UNIT UNTIL ABLE TO MAINTAIN 41F OR BELOW. A FOLLOW UP INSPECTION WILL OCCUR ON OR AROUND 10 DAYS to VERIFY UNIT has been repaired.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. Observed unapproved splitter installed on mop faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CFM will remove splitter. EHS will email approved backflow prevention device product information to owner for purchase if needed.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed cracked/missing coving tiles near back exit door. Observed back exit door door sweep in need or replace/repair as opening to outside was present in corner of door.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Repair tiles. Repair/replace door sweep.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. PIC stated he is a CFM, but was unable to provide a copy of the CFM certificate or card.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s)(cut lettuce, cut tomatoes on the make line) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time when the food item is removed from temperature control and the time 4 hours later.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. TIME WAS DOCUMENTED.
